faqs.question: How does the ₹2,000 minimum work?
faqs.answer: To provide direct-from-brand wholesale pricing, maximum savings, and free scheduled doorstep delivery, all monthly baskets require a minimum value of ₹2,000.

faqs.question: Can I edit or cancel a placed order?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can edit item quantities or cancel your order anytime before the local hub begins packing your basket.

faqs.question: How do subscriptions & baskets work?
faqs.answer: You can tap "Save as a basket" on any active cart to create a reusable template. Next month, open Saved Baskets and reorder in one tap with verified live rates.

faqs.question: Delivery slots and timing
faqs.answer: We offer planned 3-hour delivery windows: Morning (7:00 AM - 10:00 AM), Afternoon (12:00 PM - 3:00 PM), and Evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM).
